name: theme-extension-development
description: Frontend asset build of the TYPO3 extension theme_extension_development.

scripts.build:icons:copy: npm run build:icons:solid && npm run build:icons:brands && npm run build:icons:meta
scripts.build:icons:brands: node -e "const f=require('node:fs'),r=process.env.THEME_ICONS_DIR,n=require('./package.json').fontAwesomeBrands;if(!r){throw new Error('THEME_ICONS_DIR is not set.')}if(!Array.isArray(n)||n.length===0){throw new Error('package.json has no \"fontAwesomeBrands\" allowlist.')}const d=r+'/Brands';f.rmSync(d,{recursive:true,force:true});f.mkdirSync(d,{recursive:true});for(const b of n){f.copyFileSync('node_modules/@fortawesome/fontawesome-free/svgs/brands/'+b+'.svg',d+'/'+b+'.svg')}"
scripts.build:icons:verify: rm -rf .Build/icons-verify && THEME_ICONS_DIR=.Build/icons-verify/FontAwesome npm run build:icons:copy && npm run build:icons:verify:attribution && npm run build:icons:verify:diff
scripts.build:icons:verify:attribution: test -f Resources/Public/Icons/FontAwesome/ATTRIBUTION.txt || { echo "Resources/Public/Icons/FontAwesome/ATTRIBUTION.txt is missing. The icons are CC BY 4.0 and it is their attribution, maintained by hand - see docs/development/icons.md." >&2; exit 1; }; cp Resources/Public/Icons/FontAwesome/ATTRIBUTION.txt .Build/icons-verify/FontAwesome/ATTRIBUTION.txt
scripts.build:icons:verify:diff: diff -r .Build/icons-verify/FontAwesome Resources/Public/Icons/FontAwesome || { echo "Resources/Public/Icons/FontAwesome/ differs from what buildIcons writes plus ATTRIBUTION.txt. \"Only in Resources/Public/Icons/FontAwesome\" is not written by the build: remove it. \"Only in .Build/icons-verify\" is missing, and a file that differs was edited: run buildIcons. See docs/development/icons.md." >&2; exit 1; }
